inclusions.text: Private transfer from your hotel to the airport
inclusions.source: A private transfer from your hotel to the airport is included, and the ground team handles check-in and the pre-flight safety briefing before you board.

inclusions.text: Check-in and pre-flight safety briefing by the ground team
inclusions.source: A private transfer from your hotel to the airport is included, and the ground team handles check-in and the pre-flight safety briefing before you board.

inclusions.text: Private helicopter tour, roughly 40 to 60 minutes in the air
inclusions.source: The Cairo Sky Adventure is a private helicopter tour — roughly 40 to 60 minutes in the air — departing from Almaza Airport in Heliopolis and tracing a circuit over the Giza plateau, the Nile corridor, and the medieval heart of the city.

inclusions.text: Private transfer back to your hotel
inclusions.source: The return leg sweeps back over the contemporary skyline before the helicopter sets down at Almaza, where a private transfer returns you to your hotel.
